drafts.subject: Re: New PO HLA-24019 – HL-TS-310 crew tee
drafts.body:
Hi Emily,

Thank you for your email. I acknowledge the request to book a new PO HLA‑24019 for 3,000 pcs of HL‑TS‑310 men’s crew neck tees at USD 4.20 per piece, FOB Tuticorin, with the size/colour breakdown you provided.

Our current schedule shows that the requested ex‑factory date of 29 January 2027 is not feasible due to capacity constraints; the earliest we can ship the full 3,000 pcs is 23 February 2027. Please let us know if this date works for you, or if you would prefer to discuss alternative options.

All other details (price, Incoterms, port, destination) are confirmed as stated.

Best regards,  
Karthik  
Merchandiser  
Sri Velan Knits
